name: Gaff
direction: Ink, white and Atlantic blue (UX redesign, section 8)

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: The page. White in light; homes’ photographs bring the colour.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, sheets and menus. In light it is the page’s white, held off it by a hairline or a shadow, not a tint.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: The one quiet fill: a selected row, the “what happens next” panel, skeletons, hover.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any surface. A blue-black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, timestamps, helper lines.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the primary, brand and danger fills.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between groups and around a card. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: The edge of inputs, choices and secondary buttons (3:1 on every surface).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one main button on a screen. It is ink.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of the primary button.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The accent, Atlantic blue: the wordmark’s full stop, progress, the selected state. One value to change (UX-DS-6).

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: The accent as text: links and the focus ring.

tokens.name: brand-bg
tokens.usage: The tint behind a selected choice or a brand moment.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done, verified, passed: check results, signed, paid. Text and icons.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Tint for success pills and notices.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention, including a renter who did not meet a check. Text and icons.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Tint for warning pills and notices.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Something went wrong (a send failed), a field to fix, or a destructive action. Never for a renter who failed a check.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of the destructive button.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Tint for danger pills and notices.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices and viewings booked. Teal, so it never reads as the brand blue.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Tint for info pills and notices.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: Anything Gaff’s assistant wrote or suggested (“Drafted by AI”). The assistant’s work carries Gaff’s colour.

tokens.name: ai-bg
tokens.usage: Background for the AI label and the AI tile.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px outline, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind sheets, dialogs and menus.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: A screen’s title on a desktop; a question in a step-by-step flow.

styles.name: display-mobile
styles.usage: The same at phone width, and on the private pages.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Sub-headings, and a list row’s title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Thanks for your interest. We’ll be in touch by Friday either way.
styles.usage: Everything else, in the workspace too. The minimum on private pages.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary lines in the workspace only. Never a whole table.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Status pills and table headers, in sentence case. Never an eyebrow above a title.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Fine print. Never for anything to act on.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label; tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related items: a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside compact controls and rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on a phone; the side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Row insets in lists.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on a desktop; between fields in a form.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between a page’s header and its content on a desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between major page regions.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: The largest gap: above a page’s end, around an empty state.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: The one height of every button, input, select and choice row, everywhere.

tokens.name: size-target
tokens.usage: The smallest target of anything interactive.

tokens.name: size-chip
tokens.usage: The visible height of a chip, tab or small quiet button (its target is still 44px).

tokens.name: size-choice-card
tokens.usage: The least height of a choice card with an icon and a line of help.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: The least height of a list row. The whole row is the target.

tokens.name: size-bar
tokens.usage: The top bar, and the bottom tab bar (plus the phone’s safe area).

tokens.name: size-footer
tokens.usage: The fixed footer of a flow, holding a 48px button.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Icons in rows and buttons.

tokens.name: size-icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icons in navigation and choice cards.

tokens.name: size-field-short
tokens.usage: A short input: about 8 characters (a number, an Eircode).

tokens.name: size-field-medium
tokens.usage: A medium input: about 16 characters (a licence number, a date).

tokens.name: size-task
tokens.usage: The column of a single task or flow.

tokens.name: size-page
tokens.usage: The width of lists, the calendar and a letting.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips and small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, choice cards and list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and photos.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: A soft, low shadow: the fixed footer of a flow, the top bar when scrolled, a card over a photo.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Things that float over the page: sheets, dialogs, menus, pickers and toasts.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press and focus: colour only.

tokens.name: motion-base
tokens.usage: Moving between the steps of a flow; a progress bar filling.

tokens.name: motion-slow
tokens.usage: A sheet or dialog arriving; a tick drawing once.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Most movement.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Things arriving on screen.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Things leaving the screen.

motion.reducedMotion: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, motion-fast, motion-base and motion-slow are 0ms.

rules.large: Large text (24px+, or 19px bold) and fills: 3:1 or more
rules.ui: Edges, focus rings and controls: 3:1 or more
